description: This file contains unit tests for the RecorderType's Writer and Reader classes, including test classes WriterClass and ReaderClass, and a test case 'test_writer' that exercises their functionality.

classes.name: WriterClass
classes.description: A test-specific writer class inheriting from RecorderType<uint32_t, BLOCKSIZE>::Writer, with a method WriterJob() that sets buffer, creates a record, and calls various methods.

classes.name: ReaderClass
classes.description: A test-specific reader class inheriting from RecorderType<uint32_t, BLOCKSIZE>::Reader, with a method ReaderJob() that manipulates time, navigates records, and performs assertions.

methods.name: WriterJob
methods.description: Method in WriterClass that sets a buffer, creates a record, and calls Time(), Source(), and Value().

methods.name: ReaderJob
methods.description: Method in ReaderClass that manipulates time, navigates records, and performs assertions on record positions.
